stories.detail: 7 two-pointers on holes 1-7 - the card is getting boring in the best way

stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 15-18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ from 18 holes - finding the scoreboard everywhere

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

comingLast.roast: deadlocked with Holle for the double blue - the bar has picked sides
on 17 with 4 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
tied with O'Connell - two men, two blue balls, maths pending
1 above O'Connell from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
1 point is all that separates him from a very blue evening
in with a 3-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
finished 3 above the blue line - toasting every point O'Connell does not score
above the blue balls by 3 - margin thinner than the clubhouse gravy
done and dangling 4 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
